Title: ESoundInstanceLimitRule
Overview: Defines whether an AudioSuperComponent has a max sound instance limit. If so, should the instance limit apply locally per actor or globally.
Values: There will be no sound limiting for this sound (not including global limiting by the AudioManagerSubsystem).
All instances of the sound that exist will be accounted.
Each actor has its own count of sound instances and requests to instantiate a sound only consider the actor making the request.
